body: Phone verification of PRs #208 to #211 is done. It used the Galaxy Note 10+ and a plain profile APK built from d36b748. The report is at ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/results/android/a11y-verify/REPORT.md.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Findings:** the merged phone tool reports 494 findings before and 44 after, on 51 re-captured screens. The 44 break down as 17 Flutter dismiss barriers, 6 Flutter text-menu items, 12 accepted to-do lines and 9 others.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Confirmed on the phone:**U+000AU+002D To-do areas meet exactly, no longer overlap, and sit inside the note.U+000AU+002D Finger tick and untick work, including in the old overlap zone.U+000AU+002D The hidden pill no longer swallows taps, and the revealed pill's tap area starts at its painted top.U+000AU+002D The video scrubber is disabled until it can seek, then becomes an enabled SeekBar.U+000AU+002D Finger text selection works in the viewer and the editor.U+000AU+002D Each item is read once.U+000AU+002D Controls are 48 dp.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Regression from #209:** with the calendar month picker open, the phone's accessibility tree is empty (7 unlabelled nodes, against 47 before the fixes). A probe APK without the picker's BlockSemantics wrapper exposes the picker (73 nodes), which pins the cause to that wrapper. Widget tests show the full tree either way, and the mechanism is not yet explained.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Remaining problems, none caused by these PRs:**U+000AU+002D The day sheet's "Change mood" button (DayMoodCard) is 32.8 dp tall and reads the mood twice. No sweep state covers it.U+000AU+002D The More formats menu items cannot be reached by screen-reader touch; they hang under the More formats button inside the scroller.U+000AU+002D The pill's top 15 dp cannot be reached by screen-reader touch.U+000AU+002D The video scrubber is still reported clickable with no role before playing.U+000AU+002D With the keyboard open, the toast covers Task list by 43 by 44 dp. The task chip was reissued as task_e34a20a1 with these phone figures.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Painted shifts from #209:**U+000AU+002D Tab bar items up to 3.8 dp to the right.U+000AU+002D The previous-month arrow about 8 dp to the left.U+000AU+002D The format bar hides Quote, Link, Table and More formats behind a scroll with no visual cue.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Other changes:**U+000AU+002D Data: today's mood (2026-09-26) was set to Calm; everything else was restored.U+000AU+002D The sweep REPORT.md blind spot 2 was corrected to "clip artifact".U+000AU+002D The phone runs the merged build again.
